overview.tagline: A running plant, a real industrial historian and a Fuuz-shaped GraphQL API on your own machine, in one command.

mainImage.alt: ACE Docker Simulator: Fuuz title card

description: Part of ACE (Auto Contextualization Engine) from the Fuuz Industrial Operations Platform. Five containers stand up an OPC UA server with 88 simulated tags across 8 units (with realistic COMMS, STALE, FLATLINE and DRIFT faults), a MongoDB time-series historian, a Fuuz-shaped GraphQL API, an OPC UA-to-historian bridge and an operations console.
No account, tenant or configuration is needed; Docker is the only prerequisite. An opt-in orchestrator runs ACE matching and classification against a live Fuuz tenant.

highlights.title: A running plant
highlights.body: An OPC UA server with 88 simulated tags across 8 units, with realistic COMMS, STALE, FLATLINE and DRIFT faults.

highlights.title: A real historian
highlights.body: MongoDB time-series storage, fed from OPC UA subscriptions with deadband and a sample on every quality change.

highlights.title: A Fuuz-shaped API
highlights.body: A GraphQL API shaped like Fuuz's, plus an operations console at localhost:8081.

support.sla: No service level agreement. Supported once implemented by a Fuuz services professional or an approved Fuuz partner.

security.residency: On the machine that runs the containers
security.externalDetail: Only with the opt-in fuuz profile: it connects to the Fuuz tenant you configure (FUUZ_HOST, FUUZ_TENANT, FUUZ_TOKEN). By default nothing leaves your machine.

steps.text: In the folder, run docker compose up -d: 5 containers, no configuration.
Open http://localhost:8081 for the operations console.
Optional: to match and classify against a live Fuuz tenant, fill in FUUZ_HOST, FUUZ_TENANT and FUUZ_TOKEN in .env, then run docker compose --profile fuuz up -d.
